candidates.claim: DMZ_IN entry 1 permits the jump host 10.10.20.30/32 any IP protocol to the whole OT subnet 10.10.10.0/24, while approved service A4 allows only tcp/3389 to the engineering workstation 10.10.10.40.
candidates.remediation: Replace DMZ_IN entry 1 with a permit limited to tcp destination port 3389 to 10.10.10.40/32 and remove the OT-wide permit.

candidates.claim: fw-01 DMZ_IN entry 1 differs from the approved baseline: the baseline permitted tcp/3389 from 10.10.20.30/32 to 10.10.10.40/32 only, while the current configuration permits ip from 10.10.20.30/32 to 10.10.10.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the deviation by restoring the approved baseline entry or documenting the change through change control.

clarifications.question: The approved trunk sets allow VLAN 10 on sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and Gi1/0/24, but the I3 rule says only OT-facing ports (sw-ot-01 ports 1-16) may be active in VLAN 10. Is VLAN 10 on these DMZ-core trunks an intended exception, or should it be removed?

rtr-01 has two default routes: 0.0.0.0/0 via 198.51.100.1 out GigabitEthernet0/0/0 (rtr-01:54) and 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.10.99.1 out the management interface GigabitEthernet0 (rtr-01:55). Which path is intended, and should rtr-01 be able to forward traffic into MGMT through fw-01?

fw-01 has asa_http_server enabled (fw-01:109), and rtr-01 permits tcp/443 from any source to the fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2 (rtr-01:68). Is any HTTPS or ASDM access to fw-01 on the outside address intended? The management policy allows it only on the mgmt interface, from MGMT.
